name: branding-cybersecurity-brand-identity-board
title: Dark Cybersecurity Identity Board
whatItIs: A bento-grid brand presentation for a security company: monospace typography specimen 'Aa', browser tab, phone hero, severity color chips, embossed black business card, dashboard on a monitor beside a satellite dish, a black logo tile with a slashed oval mark and a story-format slide.
whatItMeans: Black surfaces, monospace type and a single abstract oval mark feel precise and vigilant. The mixed mockups prove the identity works across product and print.
techniques: Bento grid of unequal tiles combining logo, type, color, mockups
Monospace typeface as the identity's core voice
Severity chips (critical, high, medium, low) as a functional color system
Embossed dot texture on the business card surface
Faint grid lines behind dark tiles for a technical feel
bestFor: Systems that must span UI and marketing

vocabulary.definition: A grid of differently sized tiles presenting a brand's assets.
A tile showing the typeface with 'Aa' and a name.
Colors assigned to meanings rather than only aesthetics.
